Select: drug chembl_id, drug pref_name, indication mesh_id, indication mesh_heading, indication efo_id AS indication_curie, indication efo_term AS indication_label, indication max_phase_for_ind. Source: molecule_dictionary, drug_indication. Join: molecule_dictionary.molregno = drug_indication.molregno. Filter: molecule_dictionary.max_phase = 4 AND drug_indication.max_phase_for_ind = 4. Sort: chembl_id ASC, pref_name ASC, mesh_id ASC, mesh_heading ASC, indication_curie ASC, indication_label ASC, max_phase_for_ind ASC.
